Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate Code uniquely assigned to the security symbol for the day

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: Market data redistributors should process this message to populate the Financial Status Indicator (required display field) and the Market Category (recommended display field) for NASDAQ-listed issues.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate Code uniquely assigned to the security symbol for the day.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the directory message was generated. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the NASDAQ execution system.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Indicates listing market or listing market tier for the issue

Field.Name: Financial Status Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates when a firm is not in compliance with NASDAQ continued listing requirements

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Denotes the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue

Field.Name: Round Lots Only
Field.Description: Indicates if Nasdaq system limits order entry for issue

Field.Name: Issue Classification
Field.Description: Identifies the security class for the issue as assigned by NASDAQ

Field.Name: Issue Sub Type
Field.Description: Identifies the security sub-type for the issue as assigned by NASDAQ

Field.Name: Authenticity
Field.Description: Denotes if an issue or quoting participant record is set-up in NASDAQ systems in a live/production, test, or demo state

Field.Name: Short Sale Threshold Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates if a security is subject to mandatory close-out of short sales under SEC Rule 203(b)(3).

Field.Name: IPO Flag
Field.Description: Indicates if the NASDAQ security is set up for IPO release

Field.Name: LULD Reference Price Tier
Field.Description: Indicates which Limit Up / Limit Down price band calculation parameter is to be used for the instrument

Field.Name: ETP Flag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the security is an exchange traded product

Field.Name: ETP Leverage Factor
Field.Description: Tracks the integral relationship of the ETP to the underlying index

Field.Name: Inverse Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates the directional relationship between the ETP and underlying index. Example: An ETP Leverage Factor of 3 and an Inverse value of 'Y' indicates the ETP will decrease by a value of 3.

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security to the trading community

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: Indicates the current trading state for the stock

Message.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message
Message.Description: Nasaq processes orders based on the most Reg SHO Restriction status value

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination

Message.Name: Market Participant Position Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq will send out this message only if Nasdaq Operations changes the status of a market participant firm in an issue

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Denotes the market participant identifier for which the position message is being generated

Field.Name: Primary Market Maker
Field.Description: Indicates if the market participant firm qualifies as a Primary Market Maker in accordance with NASDAQ marketplace rules

Field.Name: Market Maker Mode
Field.Description: Indicates the quoting participant's registration status in relation to SEC Rules 101 and 104 of Regulation M

Field.Name: Market Participant State
Field.Description: Indicates the market participant's current registration status in the issue

Message.Name: MWCB Decline Level Message
Message.Description: Informs data recipients what the daily MWCB breach points are set to for the current trading day.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the MWCB Decline Level message was generated

Message.Name: MWCB Status Level Message
Message.Description: Informs data recipients when a MWCB has breached one of the established levels

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the MWCB Breaker Status message was generated

Field.Name: Breached Level
Field.Description: Denotes the MWCB Level that was breached

Message.Name: IPO Quoting Period Update
Message.Description: Indicates the anticipated IPO quotation release time of a security.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the IPQ Quoting Period Update message was generated

Field.Name: IPO Quotation Release Time
Field.Description: Denotes the IPO release time, in seconds since midnight, for quotation to the nearest second

Field.Name: IPO Price
Field.Description: Denotes the IPO price to be used for intraday net change calculations

Message.Name: LULD Auction Collar Message
Message.Description: Indicates the auction collar thresholds within which a paused security can reopen following a LULD trading pause

Field.Name: Auction Collar Reference Price
Field.Description: Reference price used to set the auction collars

Field.Name: Upper Auction Collar Price
Field.Description: Indicates the price of the upper auction collar threshold

Field.Name: Lower Auction Collar Price
Field.Description: Indicates the price of the lower auction collar threshold

Field.Name: Auction Collar Extension
Field.Description: Indicates the number of extensions to the Reopening Auction

Message.Name: Operational Halt Message
Message.Description: An Operational Halt means that there has been an interruption of service on the identified security impacting only the designated Market Center

Field.Name: Operational Halt Action
Field.Description: Indicates the operational halt action for the security

Message.Name: Add Order No MPID Attribution Message
Message.Description: This message will be generated for unattributed orders accepted by the Nasdaq system

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the new order at the time of receipt

Field.Name: Buy Sell Indicator
Field.Description: The type of order being added

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The total number of shares associated with the order being added to the book

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order

Message.Name: Add Order with MPID Attribution Message
Message.Description: This message will be generated for attributed orders and quotations accepted by the Nasdaq system

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the new order at the time of receipt

Field.Name: Buy Sell Indicator
Field.Description: The type of order being added

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The total number of shares associated with the order being added to the book

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order

Field.Name: Attribution
Field.Description: Nasdaq market participant identifier associated with the entered order

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the new order at the time of receipt

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The Nasdaq generated day-unique Match Number of this execution

Message.Name: Order Executed With Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part at a price different from the initial display price

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the new order at the time of receipt

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The Nasdaq generated day-unique Match Number of this execution

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the execution should be reflected on time and sale displays and volume calculations

Field.Name: Execution Price
Field.Description: The price at which the order execution occurred

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is modified as a result of a partial cancellation

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being reduced

Field.Name: Canceled Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares being removed from the display size of the order as the result of a cancellation

Message.Name: Order Delete Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is being cancelled

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being canceled

Message.Name: Order Replace Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book has been cancel-replaced

Field.Name: Original Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The original reference number of the order being replaced

Field.Name: New Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The new reference number for this order at time of replacement

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The new display price for the order

Message.Name: (Non-Cross) Trade Message
Message.Description: Trade Messages should be included in NASDAQ time-and-sales displays as well as volume and other market statistics

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the order on the book being executed. Effective December 6, 2010, NASDAQ OMX will populate this field as zero.

Field.Name: Buy Sell Indicator
Field.Description: The type of non-display order on the book being matched. Effective 07/14/2014, this field will always be "B" regardless of the resting side.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares being matched in this execution

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The match price of the order. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The Nasdaq generated session-unique Match Number for this trade. The Match Number is referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Message.Name: Cross Trade Message
Message.Description: Cross Trade message indicates that Nasdaq has completed its cross process for a specific security

Field.Name: Cross Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares matched in the Nasdaq Cross

Field.Name: Cross Price
Field.Description: The price at which the cross occurred

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The Nasdaq generated day-unique Match Number of this execution

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The Nasdaq cross session for which the message is being generated

Message.Name: Broken Trade Message
Message.Description: The Broken Trade Message is sent whenever an execution on Nasdaq is broken

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The Nasdaq Match Number of the execution that was broken

Message.Name: Net Order Imbalance Indicator Message
Message.Description: NASDAQ disseminates NOII data

Field.Name: Paired Shares
Field.Description: The total number of shares that are eligible to be matched at the Current Reference Price

Field.Name: Imbalance Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares not paired at the Current Reference Price

Field.Name: Imbalance Direction
Field.Description: The market side of the order imbalance

Field.Name: Far Price
Field.Description: A hypothetical auction-clearing price for cross orders only

Field.Name: Near Price
Field.Description: A hypothetical auction-clearing price for cross orders as well as continuous orders

Field.Name: Current Reference Price
Field.Description: The price at which the NOII shares are being calculated

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The type of NASDAQ cross for which the NOII message is being generated

Field.Name: Price Variation Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates the absolute value of the percentage of deviation of the Near Indicative Clearing Price to the nearest Current Reference Price

Message.Name: Retail Price Improvement Indicator Message
Message.Description: Identifies a retail interest indication of the Bid, Ask or both the Bid and Ask for NASDAQ-listed securities.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces

Message.Name: Direct Listing with Capital Raise Price Discovery Message
Message.Description: This message is disseminated only for Direct Listing with Capital Raise (DLCR) securities

Field.Name: Open Eligibility Status
Field.Description: Indicates if the security is eligible to be released for trading

Field.Name: Near Execution Price
Field.Description: The current reference price when the DLCR volatility test has successfully passed

Field.Name: Near Execution Time
Field.Description: The time at which the Near Execution Price was determined

Field.Name: Lower Price Range Collar
Field.Description: Indicates the price of the Lower Auction Collar Threshold

Field.Name: Upper Price Range Collar
Field.Description: Indicates the price of the Upper Auction Collar Threshold

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Outside of time stamp messages, the start of day message is the first message sent in any trading day

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: This message indicates that Nasdaq is open and ready to start accepting orders

Value.Name: Start of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are available for execution

Value.Name: End of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are no longer available for execution

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: Nasdaq is now closed and will not accept any new orders today

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: Always the last message sent in any trading day

Value.Name: Creations and Redemptions Suspended
Value.Description: Creations and/or Redemptions Suspended for Exchange Traded Product

Value.Name: Normal
Value.Description: Issuer is NOT Deficient, Delinquent, or Bankrupt

Value.Name: Not Available
Value.Description: Firms should refer to SIAC feeds for code if needed

Value.Name: Yes
Value.Description: Nasdaq system only accepts round lot orders for this security

Value.Name: No
Value.Description: Nasdaq system does not have any order size restrictions for this security

Value.Name: Restricted
Value.Description: Issue is restricted under SEC Rule 203(b)(3)

Value.Name: Set Up For IPO Release
Value.Description: Nasdaq listed instrument is set up as a new IPO security

Value.Name: Not Set Up For IPO Release
Value.Description: Nasdaq listed instrument is not set up as a new IPO security

Value.Name: Non-IPO new listed security
Value.Description: Nasdaq listed instrument is a non-IPO new listed security

Value.Name: Tier 1
Value.Description: Tier 1 NMS Stocks and select ETPs

Value.Name: Not Inverse ETP
Value.Description: ETP is not an Inverse ETP

Value.Name: Halted
Value.Description: Halted across all U.S. equity markets / SROs

Value.Name: Paused
Value.Description: Paused across all U.S. equity markets / SROs (NASDAQ-listed securities only)

Value.Name: Quotation Only Period
Value.Description: Quotation only period for cross-SRO halt or pause

Value.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction in effect due to an intra-day price drop in security

Value.Name: Test Restriction Remains
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction remains in effect

Value.Name: Anticipated Quotation Release Time
Value.Description: Used when Nasdaq Market Operations initially enters the IPO instrument for release

Value.Name: IPO Release Canceled or Postponed
Value.Description: Used when Nasdaq Market Operations cancels or postpones the release of the new IPO instrument

Value.Name: Halted
Value.Description: Operationally Halted on the identified Market

Value.Name: Trading Resumed
Value.Description: Operational Halt has been lifted and Trading resumed

Value.Name: Halted or Paused
Value.Description: Cross for IPO and halted / paused securities

Value.Name: Buy Side
Value.Description: RPI orders available on the buy side

Value.Name: Sell Side
Value.Description: RPI orders available on the sell side

Value.Name: Both Sides
Value.Description: RPI orders available on both sides (buy and sell)

Value.Name: Single Security Trading Pause In Effect
Value.Description: Single Security Trading Pause In Effect

Value.Name: Trading Halted
Value.Description: Trading Halted; For Information Requested by Listing Market

Value.Name: Circuit Breaker Halt Level 1
Value.Description: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt – Level 1

Value.Name: Circuit Breaker Halt Level 2
Value.Description: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt – Level 2

Value.Name: Circuit Breaker Halt Level 3
Value.Description: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt – Level 3

Value.Name: Carry Over Circuit Breaker Halt
Value.Description: Market Wide Circuit Breaker Halt – Carry over from previous day

Value.Name: Trading Pause Quotation Only Period
Value.Description: Single Security Trading Pause / Quotation Only Period

Value.Name: Qualifications Issues Resolved
Value.Description: Qualifications Issues Reviewed/Resolved; Quotations/Trading to Resume

Value.Name: Filing Requirements Satisfied
Value.Description: Filing Requirements Satisfied/Resolved; Quotations/Trading To Resume

Value.Name: Issuer News Not Forthcoming
Value.Description: Issuer News Not Forthcoming; Quotations/Trading To Resume

Value.Name: Qualifications Halt Ended
Value.Description: Qualifications Halt ended; Maintenance Requirements Met; Resume

Value.Name: Qualifications Halt Concluded
Value.Description: Qualifications Halt Concluded; Filings Met; Quotes/Trades To Resume

Value.Name: Trade Halt Concluded By Other Regulatory Authority
Value.Description: Trade Halt Concluded By Other Regulatory Authority; Quotes/Trades Resume

Value.Name: IPO Security Released
Value.Description: IPO Security Released for Quotation (NASDAQ Securities Only)

Value.Name: IPO Security Positioning Window Extension
Value.Description: IPO Security — Positioning Window Extension (NASDAQ Securities Only)

Value.Name: Next Shares Exchange Traded Managed Fund
Value.Description: Next Shares Exchange Traded Managed Fund

Value.Name: Limited Liability Company
Value.Description: Identifies securities of companies that are set up as a Limited Liability Company (LLC)

Value.Name: ETN Multi Factor Index Linked Securities
Value.Description: ETN Multi Factor Index Linked Securities
